title: Minimal Example
script: This is the simplest possible video. Just a script and a title. Everything else uses defaults.

The future is here.

title: Burned Captions Default
script:
Burned captions are permanently part of the video.
They work on every platform and device.
No external subtitle file needed.

title: Karaoke Word Highlight
script:
Karaoke mode highlights each word one by one.
This creates an engaging visual rhythm.
Perfect for music and motivational content.

title: No Captions At All
script:
This video has no on-screen text.
Use this for cinematic or artistic content.
Let the visuals speak for themselves.

title: Minimal Caption Theme
script:
Minimal captions are clean and subtle.
White text with no background box.
Best for elegant, professional content.

title: Bold Caption Theme
script:
Bold captions use thicker text.
They stand out against any background.
Great for high-energy content.

title: High Contrast Caption Theme
script:
High contrast uses yellow text on dark background.
Maximum readability in any lighting.
Perfect for accessibility-focused content.

title: Soft Card Caption Theme
script:
Soft Card has a semi-transparent background.
Text is white with subtle dark backing.
Balanced between clean and readable.

title: Center Pop Caption Theme
script:
Center pop places text in the middle of the screen.
Larger font size for dramatic emphasis.
Best for quote-style content.

title: Top Tag Caption Theme
script:
Top Tag positions text at the top of the screen.
Leaves the bottom clear for visuals.
Useful for news or interview formatting.

title: Neon Caption Theme
script:
Neon captions glow with vibrant colors.
Cyan and magenta create a cyberpunk feel.
Perfect for tech and gaming content.

title: Multiple Voice Options
script:

Pick the one that fits your content best.

script:

script:

title: Documentary Preset
script:

title: Neutral Preset
script:
The neutral preset removes most visual effects.
No Ken Burns, no vignette.
Clean and straightforward presentation.

script:

script:
Zoom blur adds motion blur between scenes.
Creates a dynamic, high-energy feel.
Perfect for action and motivational content.

title: Hard Cut Transitions
script:
Hard cuts are instant with no transition.
They keep pacing tight and fast.
Ideal for news and fast-paced content.

title: Cool Color Grade

script:

AI vision verification checks every asset.
Subject match, watermark, and safety.

Very strict verification gate.
Only the best visuals make it through.

script:

script:

script:
Limits the AI model to at most 20 calls per run.
